decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 30 July 2003, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension to the dwellinghouse with rear dormer dimensions of 5.18m long by 3.782m deep with a height of 2.3m, that adds 22.52m3, a gable end with dimensions of 7.92m long by 3.803m deep with a height of 2.3m, that adds 11.54m3 and the existing single storey extension of 10.48m3 provides a total volume of 34.06m3, qualifies as Class A permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 

The proposed roof extension, therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a roof extension incorporating a hip to gable roof to dwellinghouse
